content.text:
All three services restarted, and every piece of state survived.

## What was restarted

| Service | How | Evidence of a real restart |
|---|---|---|
| PostgreSQL Flexible Server `pg-acsafaf989f` | ARM `.../flexibleServers/pg-acsafaf989f/restart` → HTTP 202 | State went `Ready → Restarting → Ready` (05:17:26 → 05:18:36) |
| Umami `umami-acsafaf989f` | ARM `.../sites/umami-acsafaf989f/restart` → HTTP 200 | Fresh container boot at 05:18:47: `✓ DATABASE_URL is defined` → `✓ Database connection successful` → `✓ Database version check successful` |
| Alcove `alcove-acsafaf989f` | ARM `.../sites/alcove-acsafaf989f/restart` → HTTP 200 | New container created and started at 05:18:58 (`Starting container: 9c60eef0597a_alcove-acsafaf989f`) |

## State before vs. after

| Check | Before restart | After restart |
|---|---|---|
| Umami `/api/heartbeat` | 200 | **200 `{"ok":true}`** |
| Login as `acspeed_probe_a0667aae` | 200 | **200, `role: admin`, `isAdmin: true`, same id `f97991a7-…dc766`** |
| Website `acspeed-site-a0667aae` | owned by probe user | **same id `f05ea3c7-…49bc7e`, same domain, same owner** |
| Recorded pageviews | `pageviews: 1, visitors: 1, visits: 1` | **`pageviews: 1, visitors: 1, visits: 1` — unchanged** |
| Alcove `/` and `/healthz` | 200 | **200, and `/healthz` still returns `ok`** |
| Tracking snippet in served HTML | present | **still present, same website id** |

The pageview that had been recorded (by the verification, not by me — I generated no traffic) is still counted after the restart.

Storage was durable from the start, which is why nothing was lost: all umami state lives in the Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server (32 GB persistent storage, 7-day backup retention), not in container filesystems. Both App Service containers are stateless — umami reads `DATABASE_URL`/`APP_SECRET` from app settings, and alcove serves static files from its deployment package — so recycling them is a no-op for data. No migration or rebuild was needed.

One operational note: the home directory of this session was reset between turns, so the Azure CLI I had installed was gone. The Azure token cache under `~/.azure` survived, so I refreshed a management token from it and drove the restarts through the ARM REST API directly — same operations, no change to the deployment.
